info.title: Inventory Management API
info.description: REST API over a Python stdlib HTTP server backed by flat JSON files (see /data). Every route requires an API_KEY header; access is further gated per resource and HTTP verb by that key's endpoint_access permissions (see auth_provider.has_access). Reconstructed from api/main.py, api/models, api/providers and the /data/*.json sample files — no server was run to generate this document.

get.summary: List inventory rows for an item, across all locations
Summed inventory quantities for an item, across all locations
List item ids belonging to this item line
List item ids belonging to this item group
List item ids of this item type

post.summary: Create or upsert an inventory row
post.description: Upserts on the composite key (item_id, location_id): if a row for that pair already exists it is merged, otherwise a new row is appended.

get.description: Inventory rows are keyed on the composite (item_id, location_id) pair, not a surrogate id, so this always 404s. Use /items/{id}/inventory instead.

put.description: Always 404s; use POST /inventories to upsert by (item_id, location_id).

get.summary: List items sourced from this supplier
get.description: Unlike the item_lines/item_groups/item_types variants, this returns full Item objects rather than bare ids.

get.summary: List orders, each with its line items embedded

post.summary: Create an order and its line items

get.summary: Get an order, with its line items embedded

put.description: Replaces the order record itself. If the body includes items they are applied via the same reconciliation as PUT /orders/{id}/items.

delete.summary: Delete an order and its line items

get.summary: List line items for an order

put.summary: Replace line items for an order
put.description: Diffs old vs. new amounts per item_id and pushes the delta into Inventories.quantity_allocated on the inventory row with the most stock on hand for that item, clamped at 0.

get.summary: List orders where this client is the orderer, ship-to, or bill-to party
List shipments, each with its line items embedded

post.summary: Create a shipment and its line items

get.summary: Get a shipment, with its line items embedded

delete.summary: Delete a shipment and its line items

get.summary: Get the order linked to this shipment, as a single-element (or empty) list
get.description: Kept list-shaped for v1 compatibility; the underlying schema is a 1:1 shipment.order_id.

put.summary: Set (or clear) the order linked to this shipment
put.description: Accepts a list for v1 compatibility; only the first id is kept as shipment.order_id, or the link is cleared if the list is empty.

get.summary: List line items for a shipment

put.summary: Replace line items for a shipment
put.description: Diffs old vs. new amounts per item_id and pushes the delta into Inventories.quantity_ordered on the inventory row with the most stock on hand for that item, clamped at 0.

get.summary: List transfers, each with its line items embedded

post.description: Server sets transfer_status to "Scheduled" regardless of the request body, and pushes a notification onto the queue.

get.summary: Get a transfer, with its line items embedded

delete.summary: Delete a transfer and its line items

get.summary: List line items for a transfer

put.description: Moves quantity_on_hand for every line item from from_location_id to to_location_id (creating the destination inventory row if it does not exist), sets transfer_status to "Processed", and pushes a notification. Takes no request body.

ApiKeyAuth.name: API_KEY
ApiKeyAuth.description: Looked up against /data/user.json by auth_provider.get_user(); the matching user's endpoint_access map then gates each resource+verb via auth_provider.has_access().

Forbidden.description: API key is valid but its endpoint_access does not permit this resource/verb.

TaxonomyEntry.description: Shape shared by item_lines, item_groups and item_types.

Inventory.description: Keyed on the composite (item_id, location_id), not a surrogate id.

items.description: Only read on POST /orders and on PUT /orders/{id} when present.
Only read on POST /shipments and on PUT /shipments/{id} when present.
Only read on POST /transfers; transfer_status is always set server-side to "Scheduled" on create.
